How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your Timer Outlet Warmer and Calming Lavender melts, here’s a simple first run:
Plug the warmer into an outlet and make sure its silicone dish is in place.
Put 1–2 wax melt bears in the dish. You don’t need an extra liner.
Turn the warmer on and choose a timer setting. For your first try, 3 hours is a good way to see how you like the scent; the warmer also has 6- and 9-hour settings.
Stay in the room while it’s on, and turn it off before you go to sleep or leave. When you’re finished, let the wax cool and harden completely before popping it out of the dish.
You don’t have to remove the wax after that first session just because the timer ended—wait until you’re ready to change it.
